items.title: DE Q4 Earnings Call Points to a Gradual Farm Equipment Recovery
items.summary: Deere & Company (DE) sees fiscal 2026 as the bottom of the agricultural equipment cycle, with North America leading recovery as farmers replace aging machinery. The company projects fiscal 2027 net income of $4.5-$5.25 billion (roughly flat with 2026) and expects Production & Precision Agriculture sales to rise 5-15%. However, the company faces headwinds from tariff expenses (~$300M additional in fiscal 2027), labor pressures, and margin pressures from growth investments in technology and AI initiatives.

items.title: DE Boosts Precision Agriculture Capabilities With Orchard AI Buyout
items.summary: Deere & Company has acquired Orchard Robotics (Orchard AI), a San Francisco-based agricultural technology company that uses AI-powered cameras to provide crop intelligence for high-value crop growers. The acquisition combines Deere's precision agriculture expertise with Orchard AI's plant-level crop insights to help growers make better decisions. Deere is scheduled to report Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings with consensus estimates of $4.07 per share and $10.30 billion in revenue.
